svg.title: Three pipeline schedules, four stages, eight micro-batches
svg.desc: Timelines of GPipe, 1F1B and zero-bubble H1 with four stages and eight micro-batches, forward, input-gradient and weight-gradient chunks all one unit long. GPipe and 1F1B take 33 units and leave 9 idle on every stage; GPipe's first stage holds all eight micro-batches' activations, 1F1B's holds four. Zero-bubble H1 splits the backward into its input-gradient and weight-gradient halves, fills holes with weight gradients, and takes 27 units, holding four.
svg.text: Pipeline schedules: 4 stages (0-3), 8 micro-batches, F = D = W = 1 unit
GPipe: 33 units, 9 idle per stage; stage 0 holds 8 micro-batches of activations
1F1B: 33 units, 9 idle per stage; stage 0 holds 4 micro-batches of activations
Zero-bubble H1: 27 units, 3 idle per stage; stage 0 holds 4 micro-batches of activations
backward B = D + W; in H1, input-gradient D only
